methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date; per-seat/per-user tiers record the per-user monthly price with a note, while flat per-account tiers are marked billingModel flat. Where a provider quotes only the annual-billing monthly rate, that figure is recorded with annualDiscountPct null; Dropbox Sign's promo-discounted annual rate is noted rather than treated as the standard discount. Quote-only Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every plan since they do not apply to e-signature. Adobe Acrobat Sign prices were corroborated against multiple 2026 pricing sources because adobe.com timed out repeatedly via fetch.
